comments.headline: Multiple departmental approvals incomplete; plan cannot be released
comments.summary: Multiple required departmental reviews remain pending or incomplete across Fire, Pipeline Engineering, Parks and Recreation, and other departments. Approval stamps on the cover sheet are blank and no departmental signatures have been obtained. Site plan cannot be approved or released until all departmental reviews are completed and signed off.

Approval stamps on cover sheet remain blank with no departmental signatures obtained. Site plan has not been released for general compliance and remains in comment response phase.
